name: Ruri Atlas
description: JA/EN semantic search map in your browser (WebGPU)

paragraphs: In short: type a phrase or a situation in Japanese or English and watch a 3-D map of sentences light up. Sentences with similar meaning sit close together; the closest ones glow, and an optional reranker reorders them. It runs entirely in your browser (WebGPU) — nothing you type is sent anywhere. Pick the map language (日本語 / English / JA+EN) at the top right, or tap one of the example chips at the bottom to try it.

A zero-install demo of Japanese semantic search that runs entirely in your browser (WebGPU, with a WASM fallback). 96 short Japanese sentences are embedded with ruri-v3-30m and drawn as a glowing map (PCA plus a light relaxation). Type a query: it lands on the map, the nearest sentences light up, and a Japanese cross-encoder reranker (japanese-reranker-xsmall-v2, ONNX export: masahiroid/japanese-reranker-xsmall-v2-onnx-web) reorders them. Nothing you type leaves the page: the models are downloaded once and run on your GPU through transformers.js.

Models used — embedding (selectable): sirasagi62/ruri-v3-30m-ONNX (a community ONNX export of cl-nagoya/ruri-v3-30m, Apache-2.0), ruri-v3-130m-ONNX, Xenova/multilingual-e5-small (from intfloat/multilingual-e5-small), Xenova/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2; reranker: masahiroid/japanese-reranker-xsmall-v2-onnx-web (our ONNX export of hotchpotch/japanese-reranker-xsmall-v2, MIT; a larger small-v2 is also available).
